requirements_xml:
<requirements_list>
  <requirement id="R1">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>In a secure context, the Navigator interface must expose a share() method.</description>
    <spec_quote>partial interface Navigator {
            [SecureContext] Promise<undefined> share(optional ShareData data = {});
            [SecureContext] boolean canShare(optional ShareData data = {});
          };</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R2">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>In a non-secure context, the Navigator interface must not expose the share() method.</description>
    <spec_quote>[SecureContext] Promise<undefined> share(optional ShareData data = {});</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R3">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>In a secure context, the Navigator interface must expose a canShare() method.</description>
    <spec_quote>partial interface Navigator {
            [SecureContext] Promise<undefined> share(optional ShareData data = {});
            [SecureContext] boolean canShare(optional ShareData data = {});
          };</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R4">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>In a non-secure context, the Navigator interface must not expose the canShare() method.</description>
    <spec_quote>[SecureContext] boolean canShare(optional ShareData data = {});</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R5">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShareData dictionary must include an optional files member.</description>
    <spec_quote>dictionary ShareData {
            sequence<File> files;
            USVString title;
            USVString text;
            USVString url;
          };</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R6">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShareData dictionary must include an optional title member.</description>
    <spec_quote>dictionary ShareData {
            sequence<File> files;
            USVString title;
            USVString text;
            USVString url;
          };</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R7">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShareData dictionary must include an optional text member.</description>
    <spec_quote>dictionary ShareData {
            sequence<File> files;
            USVString title;
            USVString text;
            USVString url;
          };</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R8">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShareData dictionary must include an optional url member.</description>
    <spec_quote>dictionary ShareData {
            sequence<File> files;
            USVString title;
            USVString text;
            USVString url;
          };</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R9">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The user agent must define a policy-controlled permission identified by the string "web-share".</description>
    <spec_quote>This specification defines a policy-controlled permission identified by
the string `"web-share"`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R10">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>A Navigator instance's [[sharePromise]] internal slot must be initialized to null so that an initial navigator.share() call can proceed without being blocked by an existing share promise.</description>
    <spec_quote>The [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} is a promise that
    represents a user's current intent to share some data with a
    share target. It is initialized to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R11">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When navigator.share() is called in a fully active document allowed to use "web-share" with no active share and with transient activation, it must consume the user activation of the relevant global object.</description>
    <spec_quote>7. [=Consume user activation=] of |global|.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R12">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When navigator.share() is called with a ShareData dictionary containing a url member (such as a relative URL or empty string), it must parse the url against the API base URL and use a copy of the data whose url member is set to the serialized result of that parsed URL.</description>
    <spec_quote>10. If |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member is present:
    1. Let |url:URL| be the result of running the URL
       parser on |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} with |base|.
    2. Assert: |url| is {{URL}}.
    3. Set |data| to a copy of |data|, with its {{ShareData/url}}
       member set to the result of running the URL serializer
       on |url|.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R13">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When navigator.share() passes all precondition checks and data validation, it must set this.[[sharePromise]] to a new Promise, return that promise, and execute the sharing operation in parallel.</description>
    <spec_quote>12. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to be a new
    promise.
13. Return [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} and in
    parallel:</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R14">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>After the user selects a share target during navigator.share(), the user agent must activate the chosen share target, convert the ShareData into a format suitable for ingestion into that target, and transmit the converted data to the target.</description>
    <spec_quote>5. Activate the chosen share target, convert |data|
       to a format suitable for ingestion into the target, and
       transmit the converted data to the target.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R15">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Once the share data has been successfully transmitted to the share target (or to the OS if transmission to the share target cannot be confirmed), the user agent must queue a global task on the user interaction task source using the relevant global object to resolve this.[[sharePromise]] with undefined.</description>
    <spec_quote>7. Once the data has either been successfully transmitted to
       the [=share target=], or successfully transmitted to the OS (if
       the transmission to the [=share target=] cannot be confirmed),
       [=queue a global task=] on the [=user interaction task source=]
       using |global| to:
       Once a share target has been given the payload, the share
       is considered successful. If the target considers the data
       unacceptable or an error occurs, it can either recover
       gracefully, or show an error message to the end-user; it
       cannot rely on the sender to handle errors. In other words,
       the {{Navigator/share()}} method is "fire and forget"; it
       does not wait for the target to approve or reject the
       payload.
       1. [=Resolve=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}}
          with `undefined`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R16">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When resolving this.[[sharePromise]] with undefined after a successful share transmission, the user agent must reset this.[[sharePromise]] to null so that subsequent calls to navigator.share() can proceed.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. [=Resolve=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}}
          with `undefined`.
       2. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R17">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When navigator.canShare(data) is called in a fully active document allowed to use "web-share", it must return the boolean result of validating the ShareData with the relevant settings object's API base URL, without requiring transient user activation.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. Return the result of [=validate share data=] with |data| and
   [=this=]'s [=relevant settings object=]'s [=environment settings
   object/API base URL=].</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R18">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>URLs with the http or https scheme must be accepted as valid sharable schemes during share data validation.</description>
    <spec_quote>A sharable scheme is any of the following [=URL=]
[=URL/schemes=]:

* `http`
* `https`</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R19">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When validating ShareData that includes a url member, the user agent must parse the url using the URL parser with the API base URL and no encoding override, allowing relative URLs and empty strings to resolve against the base URL.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. If |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member is present:
   1. Let |url:URL| be the result of running the [=URL parser=]
      on |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member, with |base|, and no
      encoding override.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R20">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Share data validation must return true when at least one of title, text, url, or files is provided, any provided url parses to a sharable scheme, and any provided files sequence is supported, non-hostile, and either non-empty or accompanied by title, text, or url.</description>
    <spec_quote>To validate share data with |data:ShareData| and
|base:URL|, run the following steps:

1. If none of |data|'s members {{ShareData/title}},
   {{ShareData/text}}, {{ShareData/url}}, or {{ShareData/files}} are
   present, return false.
2. Let |titleTextOrUrl:boolean| be true if any of |data|'s members
   {{ShareData/title}}, {{ShareData/text}}, or {{ShareData/url}} is
   present, and false otherwise.
3. If |data|'s {{ShareData/files}} member is present:
   1. If |titleTextOrUrl| is false and |data|'s
      {{ShareData/files}} member is empty, return false.

      This causes a `{ files: [] }` dictionary to be treated as
      an empty dictionary. However, passing a dictionary like
      `{text: "text", files: []}` is fine, as `files` is just
      ignored.
   2. If the implementation does not support file sharing, return
      false.
   3. If the user agent believes sharing any of the files in
      `files` would result in a potentially hostile share (i.e., the
      user agent determines a file is malicious in some way, because
      of its contents, size, or other characteristic), return false.
4. If |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member is present:
   1. Let |url:URL| be the result of running the [=URL parser=]
      on |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member, with |base|, and no
      encoding override.
   2. If |url| is failure, return false.
   3. If the |url|'s [=URL/scheme=] is a [=local scheme=], or
      `file`, or `javascript`, or `ws`, or `wss`, return false.
   4. If |url|'s [=URL/scheme=] is not a [=sharable scheme=],
      return false.
5. Return true.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R21">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>The Web Share API must define the policy-controlled permission "web-share" with a default allowlist of 'self', allowing first-party (same-origin) contexts to use navigator.share() and navigator.canShare() by default.</description>
    <spec_quote>This specification defines a policy-controlled permission identified by
the string `"web-share"`. Its
[=policy-controlled feature/default allowlist=] is [=default
allowlist/'self'=], which means third-party contexts are not [=allowed
to use=] the API by default.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R22">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the associated Document is not fully active when navigator.share() is called, it must return a promise rejected with an InvalidStateError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>If |document| is not [=Document/fully active=], return [=a
   promise rejected with=] an {{"InvalidStateError"}}
   {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R23">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the associated Document is not allowed to use the "web-share" policy-controlled feature when navigator.share() is called, it must return a promise rejected with a NotAllowedError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>If |document| is not allowed to use "web-share",
   return [=a promise rejected with=] a {{"NotAllowedError"}}
   {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R24">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If navigator.share() is called while another share operation is already in progress ([[sharePromise]] is not null), it must return a promise rejected with an InvalidStateError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>If [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} is not `null`,
   return [=a promise rejected with=] an {{"InvalidStateError"}}
   {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R25">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the relevant global object does not have transient activation when navigator.share() is called, it must return a promise rejected with a NotAllowedError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>If |global| does not have [=transient activation=], return [=a
   promise rejected with=] a {{"NotAllowedError"}} {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R26">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If validating the share data fails when navigator.share() is called, it must return a promise rejected with a TypeError.</description>
    <spec_quote>If [=validate share data=] with |data| and |base| returns
   false, then return [=a promise rejected with=] a {{TypeError}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R27">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If a file type in the share data is blocked due to security considerations when navigator.share() is called, it must return a promise rejected with a NotAllowedError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>If a file type is being blocked due to security considerations,
    return [=a promise rejected with=] a {{"NotAllowedError"}}
    {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R28">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If there are no share targets available during a navigator.share() operation, the user agent must queue a global task on the user interaction task source to reject the share promise with an AbortError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>If there are no share targets available, [=queue a
       global task=] on the [=user interaction task source=] using
       |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"AbortError"}} {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R29">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If there are no share targets available during a navigator.share() operation, the queued task must reset [[sharePromise]] to null so subsequent share calls are not rejected as already in progress.</description>
    <spec_quote>If there are no share targets available, [=queue a
       global task=] on the [=user interaction task source=] using
       |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"AbortError"}} {{DOMException}}.
       2. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R30">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the user chooses to abort the share operation, the user agent must queue a global task on the user interaction task source to reject the share promise with an AbortError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>If the user chose to abort the share operation, [=queue a
       global task=] on the [=user interaction task source=] using
       |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"AbortError"}} {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R31">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the user chooses to abort the share operation, the queued task must reset [[sharePromise]] to null so subsequent share calls are not rejected as already in progress.</description>
    <spec_quote>If the user chose to abort the share operation, [=queue a
       global task=] on the [=user interaction task source=] using
       |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"AbortError"}} {{DOMException}}.
       2. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R32">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If an error occurs starting the chosen share target or transmitting the share data, the user agent must queue a global task on the user interaction task source to reject the share promise with a DataError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>If an error occurs starting the target or transmitting the
       data, [=queue a global task=] on the [=user interaction task
       source=] using |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"DataError"}} {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R33">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If an error occurs starting the chosen share target or transmitting the share data, the queued task must reset [[sharePromise]] to null so subsequent share calls are not rejected as already in progress.</description>
    <spec_quote>If an error occurs starting the target or transmitting the
       data, [=queue a global task=] on the [=user interaction task
       source=] using |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"DataError"}} {{DOMException}}.
       2. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R34">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the associated Document is not fully active when navigator.canShare() is called, it must return false.</description>
    <spec_quote>If |document| is not [=Document/fully active=], return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R35">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the associated Document is not allowed to use the "web-share" policy-controlled feature when navigator.canShare() is called, it must return false.</description>
    <spec_quote>If |document| is not allowed to use "web-share",
   return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R36">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Share data validation must return false if none of the title, text, url, or files members are present in the ShareData dictionary.</description>
    <spec_quote>If none of |data|'s members {{ShareData/title}},
   {{ShareData/text}}, {{ShareData/url}}, or {{ShareData/files}} are
   present, return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R37">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Share data validation must return false if the files member is present and empty and none of title, text, or url are present.</description>
    <spec_quote>If |data|'s {{ShareData/files}} member is present:
   1. If |titleTextOrUrl| is false and |data|'s
      {{ShareData/files}} member is empty, return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R38">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Share data validation must return false if the files member is present and the implementation does not support file sharing.</description>
    <spec_quote>If the implementation does not support file sharing, return
      false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R39">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Share data validation must return false if the files member is present and the user agent determines sharing any of the files would result in a potentially hostile share.</description>
    <spec_quote>If the user agent believes sharing any of the files in
      `files` would result in a potentially hostile share (i.e., the
      user agent determines a file is malicious in some way, because
      of its contents, size, or other characteristic), return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R40">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Share data validation must return false if the url member is present and running the URL parser on it with the API base URL results in failure.</description>
    <spec_quote>Let |url:URL| be the result of running the [=URL parser=]
      on |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member, with |base|, and no
      encoding override.
   2. If |url| is failure, return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R41">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Share data validation must return false if the parsed url member has a local scheme, or the scheme is "file", "javascript", "ws", or "wss".</description>
    <spec_quote>If the |url|'s [=URL/scheme=] is a [=local scheme=], or
      `file`, or `javascript`, or `ws`, or `wss`, return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R42">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Share data validation must return false if the parsed url member has a scheme that is not a sharable scheme.</description>
    <spec_quote>If |url|'s [=URL/scheme=] is not a [=sharable scheme=],
      return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R43">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>The `[[sharePromise]]` internal slot on a `Navigator` instance must be initialized to `null`, ensuring no share operation is initially considered in progress.</description>
    <spec_quote>The [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} is a promise that
    represents a user's current intent to share some data with a
    share target. It is initialized to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R44">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>If `navigator.share()` is invoked while a previous share operation is still pending (`this.[[sharePromise]]` is not `null`), it must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError` `DOMException`.</description>
    <spec_quote>5. If [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} is not `null`,
   return [=a promise rejected with=] an {{"InvalidStateError"}}
   {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R45">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>After passing the active document, permissions policy, pending share, and transient activation checks, `navigator.share()` must consume the user activation of the relevant global object, invalidating transient activation for subsequent operations.</description>
    <spec_quote>7. [=Consume user activation=] of |global|.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R46">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>After all synchronous checks and validation succeed, `navigator.share()` must set `this.[[sharePromise]]` to a new promise to mark a share operation as in progress.</description>
    <spec_quote>12. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to be a new
    promise.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R47">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>When no share targets are available, the queued task on the user interaction task source must reset `this.[[sharePromise]]` to `null` after rejecting it with an `AbortError`, clearing the pending share state for subsequent calls.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. If there are no share targets available, [=queue a
       global task=] on the [=user interaction task source=] using
       |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"AbortError"}} {{DOMException}}.
       2. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R48">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>When the user chooses to abort the share operation, the queued task on the user interaction task source must reset `this.[[sharePromise]]` to `null` after rejecting it with an `AbortError`, clearing the pending share state for subsequent calls.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. If the user chose to abort the share operation, [=queue a
       global task=] on the [=user interaction task source=] using
       |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"AbortError"}} {{DOMException}}.
       2. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R49">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>When an error occurs starting the chosen share target or transmitting the data, the queued task on the user interaction task source must reset `this.[[sharePromise]]` to `null` after rejecting it with a `DataError`, clearing the pending share state for subsequent calls.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. If an error occurs starting the target or transmitting the
       data, [=queue a global task=] on the [=user interaction task
       source=] using |global| to:
       1. [=Reject=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} with
          an {{"DataError"}} {{DOMException}}.
       2. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R50">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>Once the data has been successfully transmitted to the share target or OS, the queued task on the user interaction task source must reset `this.[[sharePromise]]` to `null` after resolving it with `undefined`, clearing the pending share state for subsequent calls.</description>
    <spec_quote>7. Once the data has either been successfully transmitted to
       the [=share target=], or successfully transmitted to the OS (if
       the transmission to the [=share target=] cannot be confirmed),
       [=queue a global task=] on the [=user interaction task source=]
       using |global| to:
       Once a share target has been given the payload, the share
       is considered successful. If the target considers the data
       unacceptable or an error occurs, it can either recover
       gracefully, or show an error message to the end-user; it
       cannot rely on the sender to handle errors. In other words,
       the {{Navigator/share()}} method is "fire and forget"; it
       does not wait for the target to approve or reject the
       payload.
       1. [=Resolve=] [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}}
          with `undefined`.
       2. Set [=this=].{{Navigator/[[sharePromise]]}} to `null`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R51">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>The `navigator.share()` method must only be exposed in secure contexts.</description>
    <spec_quote>[SecureContext] Promise<undefined> share(optional ShareData data = {});</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R52">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>The `navigator.canShare()` method must only be exposed in secure contexts.</description>
    <spec_quote>[SecureContext] boolean canShare(optional ShareData data = {});</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R53">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>The Web Share API must define a Permissions Policy policy-controlled feature identified by the string `"web-share"` with a default allowlist of `'self'`, disallowing third-party contexts from using the API by default unless explicitly delegated.</description>
    <spec_quote>This specification defines a policy-controlled permission identified by
the string `"web-share"`. Its
[=policy-controlled feature/default allowlist=] is [=default
allowlist/'self'=], which means third-party contexts are not [=allowed
to use=] the API by default.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R54">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.share()` is called and the relevant global object's associated `Document` is not allowed to use the `"web-share"` policy-controlled feature, it must return a promise rejected with a `NotAllowedError` `DOMException`.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. If |document| is not allowed to use "web-share",
   return [=a promise rejected with=] a {{"NotAllowedError"}}
   {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R55">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.canShare()` is called and the relevant global object's associated `Document` is not allowed to use the `"web-share"` policy-controlled feature, it must return `false`.</description>
    <spec_quote>3. If |document| is not allowed to use "web-share",
   return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R56">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.share()` is called and the relevant global object's associated `Document` is not fully active, it must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError` `DOMException`.</description>
    <spec_quote>3. If |document| is not [=Document/fully active=], return [=a
   promise rejected with=] an {{"InvalidStateError"}}
   {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R57">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.canShare()` is called and the relevant global object's associated `Document` is not fully active, it must return `false`.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. If |document| is not [=Document/fully active=], return false.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R58">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.share()` is called and the relevant global object does not have transient user activation, it must return a promise rejected with a `NotAllowedError` `DOMException`.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. If |global| does not have [=transient activation=], return [=a
   promise rejected with=] a {{"NotAllowedError"}} {{DOMException}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R59">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.share()` is called on a fully active document allowed to use `"web-share"` with no active share promise and with transient activation, it must consume user activation of the relevant global object.</description>
    <spec_quote>7. [=Consume user activation=] of |global|.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R60">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.share()` validates `ShareData`, it must resolve relative URLs against `this`'s relevant settings object's API base URL and reject with a `TypeError` if validation fails.</description>
    <spec_quote>8. Let |base:URL| be [=this=]'s relevant settings object's
   [=environment settings object/API base URL=].
9. If [=validate share data=] with |data| and |base| returns
   false, then return [=a promise rejected with=] a {{TypeError}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R61">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.share()` is called with a `url` member in `ShareData`, it must parse the `url` string with the URL parser against `this`'s relevant settings object's API base URL and replace the `url` member on a copy of the data with the result of running the URL serializer on the parsed URL.</description>
    <spec_quote>10. If |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member is present:
    1. Let |url:URL| be the result of running the URL
       parser on |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} with |base|.
    2. Assert: |url| is {{URL}}.
    3. Set |data| to a copy of |data|, with its {{ShareData/url}}
       member set to the result of running the URL serializer
       on |url|.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R62">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When `navigator.canShare()` validates `ShareData`, it must use `this`'s relevant settings object's API base URL as the base URL for URL resolution.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. Return the result of [=validate share data=] with |data| and
   [=this=]'s [=relevant settings object=]'s [=environment settings
   object/API base URL=].</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R63">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When validating `ShareData` with a `url` member, the URL parser must be invoked with the base URL and no encoding override so that the document's character encoding does not override URL parsing.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. If |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member is present:
   1. Let |url:URL| be the result of running the [=URL parser=]
      on |data|'s {{ShareData/url}} member, with |base|, and no
      encoding override.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
</requirements_list>
